name: salary-management-system
description: Salary management software for a 10,000-employee organisation

scripts.build: npm run build -w @salary/shared && npm run build -w @salary/api && npm run build -w @salary/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @salary/shared && npm run test -w @salary/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @salary/shared && npm run typecheck -w @salary/api && npm run typecheck -w @salary/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @salary/api && npm run lint -w @salary/web
